name: AZCubing Winter 2022

venue.name: North Ballroom
venue.details: The North Ballroom is located on the third floor of the student union.

information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AZCubingWinter2022#20938-competitor-responsibilities) tab. Join our [Facebook group](https://www.facebook.com/groups/380588094020424/) to hear about competitions in Arizona before they're announced and keep in touch with cubers in the area!
